# Holbæk Kirurgi

Holbæk Kirurgi is a surgical department in Denmark that participates in the DANIBD (Danish Inflammatory Bowel Disease) quality monitoring program. The department has documented performance in surgical outcomes for patients with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD).

According to the 2024 DANIBD annual report, Holbæk Kirurgi reported a re-operation rate of 33% for surgical procedures, which significantly exceeds the national development target of 8% [^src1]. This metric measures the proportion of patients requiring repeat surgery within 30 days of their initial surgical intervention — a key indicator of surgical quality and safety in IBD treatment. The elevated re-operation rate suggests potential areas for quality improvement at this department compared to the national benchmark.
